notes: Exterior cladding boards (mitcad#477): Mitcad's own parametric sections of industry-standard sizes, no supplier and no manufacturer's drawing. Sizes are thickness x width in mm (the actual size; a feather-edge board's thickness its thick edge).

Shiplap (rebated): a lip LT thick and LW wide on the back of the +X edge goes under the next board, whose -X edge laps over it from the front; the cover width is the width less LW. The sizes and covers are those of public product lists; the lap's sizes are Mitcad's own.

Feather-edge: a wedge from the thick edge T to the thin edge TN, each board overlapping the one under it by O. The section lies as the board is laid on the wall: turned by the angle at which its thick edge rests on the face of the board under it, so that the boards of a row step by the cover width (from the overlap) without touching but along that line.
Species: spruce. Density at 20 % moisture: spruce 450 kg/m3 (grounds in timber-sawn.json's notes).
Tolerances: as planed timber for shiplap; feather-edge boards are sawn (up to 100 mm -1/+3 mm, over 100 mm -2/+4 mm).
